02 / THE PERSON BEHIND THE QUESTIONS

j.✳

Curiosity is a good place to start.

A human lens
on a technical world.

I’m Jia. This is my space for thinking in public about AI, institutions, and the choices that connect them.

I’m drawn to the questions that sit between disciplines: How do we turn values into decisions? Who gets to shape the rules? And what does good governance look like for the person on the receiving end?

This portfolio brings those questions together through policy notes, practical frameworks, and an evolving reading list.
